safety_verdicts.content: Patient had a single episode of vomiting.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No generated fact mentions a single episode of vomiting.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: If the patient truly had a vomiting episode, omitting it can underestimate illness severity and dehydration risk, which may influence triage and safety-netting advice. A single episode is generally lower risk than persistent vomiting, but still clinically relevant in acute gastroenteritis/diarrhea.
